title: TRN-100 xe-0/1/0: no traffic after SFP replacement
note: Synthetic ticket export, the shape of a ticketing system's worklog. Added on 7.11.2026 to show a third kind of source feeding the same reader: a ticket's closing note reports an outcome for advice that was told in a chat.

worklog.author: Aino Asentaja
worklog.text: New SFP on xe-0/1/0 at TRN-100. Link is up, no traffic. Bounced the interface as the on-call's note says, no change.

worklog.author: Pekka Päivystäjä
worklog.text: Checked the service profile on xe-0/1/0 as advised in the chat: the VLAN from last month's migration was missing. Added it, traffic is back on TRN-100.

worklog.author: Aino Asentaja
worklog.text: Closing. Root cause: service profile VLAN missing after the migration. Not the SFP.
